dogecoin.text: @BitcoinUndisc I mined DOGEcoin passionately through the winter of 2013-2014 using a nice NVIDIA graphics card with cudaminer. I did this because I thought I was "too late" to Bitcoin. DOGE crashed 50% in two weeks in spring 2014 so I cashed out my DOGE to fiat + got scared of Bitcoin for years

@BitcoinUndisc My DOGEcoin mining laptop was paid for fully by my national merit scholarship at university xD truly a high IQ foolish person until I was humbled by the beating that gold and silver took (denominated in satoshis) from 2011 to 2022. I HODLed inferior money (Ag/Au) long before #BTC
